reasoning: 驗證目標：清單顯示中，使用者請求 Scroll Up 或 Scroll Down 時，HU 以「一次一列」的粒度更新顯示。關鍵情境條件：清單項目數多於單頁可顯示列數，否則捲動粒度不可觀察。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 的驗證對象是更新粒度本身（一次一列，不是一次一頁），兩個方向各一次請求即可觀察，依 §5.7 屬同一驗證目標的兩個必然結果，併為一條 TC；項目移動的確切語意（哪一項被移除、其餘如何位移）由兄弟 leaf 041/042 覆蓋，清單首末端的 wrap-around 亦在 041/042 內以邊界值覆蓋，本 leaf 不重複驗證。刻意略過：以 knob 信號驅動捲動的速率規則屬 021（browse presets 畫面）與 §1.3.14 Station List 批次，本 leaf 只驗粒度。

tcs.tc_title: Scroll request updates the list one row at a time
tcs.test_item: When a list of items is being displayed and the user selects the Scroll Up or Scroll Down function the HU will update the display one row at a time
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on one page is displayed
5. The displayed rows start at a position in the middle of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the items displayed and their order
2. Request the Scroll Down function once
3. Read the items displayed
4. Request the Scroll Up function once
5. Read the items displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. A full page of list items is displayed
2. The scroll request is accepted
3. The displayed items advance by exactly one row, and all but one of the previously displayed items are still on the page
4. The scroll request is accepted
5. The displayed items return by exactly one row to the set displayed in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
